answer: One workable design: require cross-attestation from unrelated established identities before a withdrawal clears, because vertex only stays cheap while a closed ring of clones cannot assemble independent attestations without hiring real ones. Concretely, cipher is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any jade approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
